title: Estimator output as an average
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. Given three lists of $m$ cube inputs, the rational restricted Fourier weight estimator output equals $\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=0}^{m-1} r_i$, where $r_i$ is the rational restricted Fourier weight observation formed from the $i$th inputs in the three lists and the labels supplied by $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
three input families indexed by Fin m
